items.title: 15.7.1 Addiction, Tolerance and Withdrawal Symptoms (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of addiction, tolerance and withdrawal (PDF 47-48).

blocks.text: Psychoactive drugs ka ghalat istemal (abuse) aksar dependence (inhisar) tak le jata hai. Dependence woh halat hai jis mein insan kaam kaaj ke liye jismani ya jazbati taur par kisi drug par munhasir ho jata hai. Dependence aksar addiction (lat) ban jati hai. Drug addiction ka matlab hai drug ki be-qaboo talab aur us ke bure asraat ke bawajood us ka istemal, jo ek bimari hai.

Jab insan musalsal drug istemal karta rehta hai to jism us ka aadi (adaptive) ho jata hai aur us ke asar ke liye kam hassas ho jata hai. Is halat ko drug tolerance kehte hain. Tolerance ke baad wahi asar hasil karne ke liye zyada khuraak (doses) chahiye hoti hai. Is se lat aur barh jati hai.

Jab aadi log nasha-awar (addictive) drug lena chhor dete hain to unhein withdrawal symptoms (chhorne ki alamaat) hoti hain. In mein ulti, sar dard, be-khwabi (insomnia), saans ki mushkil, depression, zehni be-qarari aur dauray (seizures) shamil ho sakte hain.
Lat aur tolerance ke dauran nervous system mein tabdeeliyan

Nasha-awar drugs dimagh ke un hisson par asar karti hain jo lutf (pleasure) aur hosle (motivation) ko qaboo karte hain. Jab yeh drugs dimagh tak pohanchti hain to presynaptic neurons dopamine neurotransmitter chhorte hain, jo khushi aur inaam (reward) ka ehsas deta hai. Kitab ke mutabiq drug ke molecules presynaptic neuron mein dopamine wapas jazb karne wale receptors ko band kar dete hain. Is liye bohat sa dopamine synaptic cleft mein jama ho jata hai. Dimagh is ka aadi ho kar postsynaptic neuron par dopamine receptors ki tadaad kam kar deta hai. Isi se tolerance hoti hai, yaani wahi lutf ya inaam ke liye zyada khuraak chahiye. Jab drug achanak band ki jaye to dopamine ka ikhraj naarmal ho jata hai, lekin receptors kam hone ki wajah se postsynaptic neuron kam jagta hai aur withdrawal symptoms aati hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar numbered synapses. 1 Aam synapse: synaptic cleft mein chhoota dopamine receptors tak jata aur presynaptic neuron wapas jazb kar leta hai. 2 Dawa wala synapse: dawa ke molecules reabsorption receptors par baith jate hain, dopamine jama hota hai. 3 Dimagh dhal jata hai: postsynaptic neuron par dopamine receptors kam. 4 Dawa hata di gayi: dopamine ka ikhraj aam magar receptors ab bhi kam.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chaaron panels ko tarteeb se parhein: (1) aam synapse mein dopamine receptors tak ja kar wapas jazb ho jata hai; (2) drug wapas jazb hona rok deti hai, dopamine jama hota hai; (3) dimagh receptors kam kar deta hai, is liye zyada drug chahiye (tolerance); (4) drug band ho to dopamine naarmal hai magar receptors kam hain, is liye neuron kam jagta hai (withdrawal).

Caffeine bohat se aam mashroobat (beverages), jaise coffee, chai aur energy drinks, mein hota hai. Yeh adenosine naam ke neurotransmitter ka asar rok sakta hai, jo neend aur sukoon laata hai. Nateeje mein caffeine chaukasi aur tawanai barhata hai.

Caffeine ka baqaida istemal tolerance paida kar sakta hai, is liye wahi chaukasi ke liye zyada khuraak chahiye hoti hai. Agar caffeine achanak band kar di jaye to sar dard aur thakan jaisi withdrawal symptoms ho sakti hain.

Nicotine tambakoo ki cheezon (cigarettes, cigars aur baghair dhuein wala tambakoo) mein maujood bohat nasha-awar stimulant (jagane wala madda) hai. Yeh dimagh ke nicotine receptors se jurti hai. Kitab ke mutabiq yeh receptors dopamine aur doosre neurotransmitters chhorte hain jo lutf ka ehsas dete hain.

Nicotine ka baqaida istemal tolerance paida karta hai, is liye wahi lutf ke liye zyada khuraak chahiye hoti hai. Jab nicotine achanak band ki jaye to chirchirapan, ghabrahat (anxiety) aur shadeed talab (cravings) jaisi withdrawal symptoms hoti hain. Nicotine ka lamba istemal sehat ke kai nuqsanat se bhi jura hai, jin mein cancer, dil ki bimari aur saans ke masail ka barha hua khatra shamil hai.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Dopamine ki wapsi rokna cocaine ka tareeqa hai; doosri nasha-awar drugs doosre tareeqon se dopamine barhati hain (maslan opioids endorphin receptors ke zariye), is liye kitab ka tareeqa saada kiya hua hai. Kitab yeh bhi likhti hai ke nicotine receptors 'dopamine chhorte hain'; dar asal yeh receptors rakhne wale neurons jag kar dopamine chhorte hain.

blocks.prompt: Roz coffee peene wale ko coffee ke baghair din sar dard kyun hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Musalsal caffeine se tolerance ban chuki hai; caffeine achanak band hone par sar dard aur thakan jaisi withdrawal symptoms aati hain.

items: Dependence (drug par inhisar), addiction (be-qaboo talab), tolerance (wahi asar ke liye zyada khuraak), withdrawal (chhorne par alamaat).

Dopamine cleft mein jama, postsynaptic receptors kam (tolerance), drug band karne par neuron kam jagta (withdrawal). Caffeine adenosine rokta hai; nicotine nicotine receptors se jur kar dopamine barhati hai.
